name: Boltzmann’s entropy and probability account
description: Boltzmann related thermodynamic entropy to the statistical likelihood of microscopic arrangements.

date.basis: Year of the dated publication, or a broad historian-estimated composition interval; no first discovery claimed.

events.statement: Boltzmann published work relating entropy and probability in 1877.

evidence.supports: Describes the 1877 statistical account of irreversibility and reversibility objections.

earliest_record.rationale: Dated witness within the inspected evidence; not a global-priority claim.

caveats: The statistical interpretation developed through multiple papers and debates. Modern microstate notation and later precise formulations should not be treated as verbatim 1877 terminology.

research.note: Independent reading checked the source-supported event and chronology. Grain and other unreviewed facets remain provisional.
